title: Dashboards, alerts and fighting alert fatigue

videos.script: An analyst who receives four hundred alerts a day stops reading them. Not on purpose. It just happens. {{fatigue}} And the alert that mattered is somewhere in the four hundred. That is alert fatigue, and it is the most common way a working SOC goes blind. {{blind}} This lesson starts with dashboards, and with the questions a dashboard has to answer. Then the alert itself: what it has to carry so that a tired person can act on it. {{alert}} Then you will watch one correct rule raise forty eight alerts for a single event, and fold them into one. {{fold}} And you will move a threshold and count what each setting costs.
